'''Scalelord''' was a title or rank used by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]]. Scalelords were seen on the [[Avatar Orbital Platform]] above [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].
